reason: My register has never failed me, and in a one-or-two chair shop where I cut hair myself I can see the chair and the drawer with my own eyes. ₹5,000 to start and ₹1,000 every month is too much from what I earn for something I don't need.
objection: After losing two good stylists last year, I can't make the one I have take a selfie to clock in. He will feel I don't trust him and walk to the salon down the road.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around ₹299 a month, just for the WhatsApp reminders and the customer list, without any selfie check-in for staff.
